ResearchProjectDef.label: food processor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn edible ingredients into liquid food for storage and feeding.

ResearchProjectDef.label: liquid food storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Store liquid food in powered, pressurized containers connected by pipes. Powered preservation pauses spoilage; outages and breakdowns let perishable contents age again.

ResearchProjectDef.label: expanded food storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build larger powered food vats. More storage takes additional materials, space and power; perishable contents still age during outages and breakdowns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: food dispenser
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build dispensers that serve meals from the colony's liquid-food network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: auto feeder
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build automatic feeders to deliver liquid food to pawns in bed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: improved auto feeder
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct and operate an improved version of the automatic dispenser, allowing for more efficient diet management.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nutrient distillation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build distilleries that concentrate liquid food into smaller, richer servings.
